Our game presents a fresh approach to the classic line and dots concept, featuring addictive gameplay and a delightful blend of familiarity and innovation that will keep you engaged. Gameplay: Strategically connect the dots to form lines and carefully encircle hens while earning eggs for each successful capture. The goal is to skillfully surround hens, providing players with an engaging objective to strive towards. Delve into the intricacies of the gameplay and experience the satisfaction of mastering this challenging puzzle that combines logic and strategy.

Use mouse or touchscreen Connect dots with lines to surround a hen in this idle logic farm puzzle
